issues.legal_issue: Statutory protection against a landlord’s ejectment of a tenant does not prevent execution of an ejectment decree obtained before the protective law came into force when the law does not extend its protection to existing decrees or execution proceedings.
material_facts: An ejectment decree had been obtained against the tenants and was later confirmed on appeal before the protective tenancy law came into force.
Execution of the decree was pending when the law came into force.
The tenants claimed that the law’s protection against eviction applied to the pending execution proceeding.
The execution court ultimately rejected that claim, and the appellate court upheld the rejection.
issues.conclusion: The protection in Section 5(1)(a) did not apply to the pending execution of an ejectment decree already obtained before the Act came into force; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(1)(a) protects qualifying tenants from a landlord’s right to eject them, but its non-obstante clause does not mention ejectment decrees already obtained. Read with Section 5(1)(b), which concerns compensation for improvements assessed under Section 6 in a suit for ejectment, the provision concerns rights being enforced in a suit rather than rights already determined by a decree. Sections 5(2) and 5(3) address ejectment by decree and execution of certain decrees, but do not extend Section 5(1)(a) to existing decrees. The conclusion is reinforced by earlier Assam enactments that expressly included execution proceedings when intended, and accords with Suresh Chandra Datta v. Ashutosh Dutta, A.I.R. 1960 Assam 24. The Court considered comparisons with legislation from other States unreliable aids to construction.

rule.if: appeal_in_execution_proceeding and ejectment_decree_precedes_protective_law and execution_pending_at_commencement and protection_targets_ejectment_right_not_existing_decrees

predicates.appeal_in_execution_proceeding: The matter is an appeal arising from an order made in proceedings to execute an ejectment decree.
predicates.ejectment_decree_precedes_protective_law: A competent court granted the ejectment decree before the protective law came into force.
predicates.execution_pending_at_commencement: Execution of the decree was pending when the protective law came into force.
predicates.protection_targets_ejectment_right_not_e: The protective law addresses a landlord’s right to eject a tenant and does not expressly extend its protection to decrees already obtained or their execution.

issues.definition: When an appeal arises from execution proceedings, an ejectment decree predates the protective law, execution remains pending at commencement, and the law protects against the right to eject rather than existing decrees, the decree remains executable.
